author: Phobiaxx
body:
Creators:TheRomanTrident,TheHoopsman,Evocal
Server-Hoster and person who eats pie:alexanderjoe10

Gameplay:There are three lanes:The Mid-Lane, The OP Lane, and The Fortified Lane.
There are 8 monuments per team. 6 in the Mid-Lane, and one each in the OP and fortified lane.
Mid-Lane:TDM-like gameplay, you can leave/join as much as you like. There are some "good" hidden items in this lane. There are two platforms for each side, then a center arena like Gladiator. There's a mix of monuments all around the arena. To break them, you'll need teammates to cover you.
  On the two platforms, there is a monument each, which you can create a defense for. There may a surprise near the monument........ You use portals to access the platforms, and the center arena.
Fortified Lane:Once you enter, you cannot get out, without owning the lane. There are some "semi-op" items for you to use. There are fortifications and towers you can use. The monument is with a pre-built fortification. You can access the OP lane from the center arena.
OP Lane:Once you enter, you cannot get out, without owning the lane. There are some "op" items for you to use. There is one tower in the center. The monument has a pre-built fortification. You can access the Fortified Lane via a center portal.
Overall Map:The spawn has iron, and a magical block... ;o The actual spawn is completely protected from the enemy, as most of the action should go on in the lanes. The map would probably take about 1-2 hours, with 3 games running at once.(The 3 lanes) YAML will prevent people from bridging from lane to lane. Big gaps are to help the YAML
